evidence.Country of Origin: College of Agronomy, Example Agricultural University, Wuhan 430070, China
evidence.Primary Organism: The genome and protein sequences of Zea mays were downloaded from Phytozome v13
evidence.Secondary Organism: Arabidopsis thaliana and Oryza sativa WRKY proteins were included in the phylogenetic tree for comparison
evidence.Gene Family: A total of 136 ZmWRKY genes were identified in the maize genome
evidence.Genome Source: The genome and protein sequences of Zea mays were downloaded from Phytozome v13
evidence.HMMER (with Pfam domains ID): The hidden Markov model profile of the WRKY domain (PF03106) was used to search the maize proteome with HMMER 3.0
evidence.BLAST (E-value cut-off used): BLASTP searches were also performed with an E-value cut-off of 1e-5
evidence.SMART: The conserved domains were confirmed with SMART
evidence.MEGA: A phylogenetic tree was constructed with MEGA 7
evidence.MEME: the conserved motifs were identified with MEME
evidence.MCScanX: Collinearity and duplication events were analysed with MCScanX
evidence.TBTools: Collinearity and duplication events were analysed with MCScanX and visualised with TBtools
evidence.Experimental Validation (qPCR): The expression of selected genes under drought stress was validated by qRT-PCR
evidence.Expression Analysis (RNA-seq): Expression profiles were obtained from publicly available RNA-seq data of maize tissues
evidence.Number of Genes Identified: A total of 136 ZmWRKY genes were identified in the maize genome
evidence.Genes per species: A total of 136 ZmWRKY genes were identified in the maize genome
